Hi Priya / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about AcmeHealth's latency and data residency needs. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align on a focused PoC: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary requirement: inference inside Acme's VPC/on-prem for PHI workloads, strict egress controls.
- Secondary: predictable latency under 100ms p50 for inference paths; cost predictability for steady-state throughput.
- Stakeholders: Priya (security/compliance), Tom (platform/infra), and App team (integration).

How Redwood maps to your needs (high level / differentiators)
- Private deployment modes:
  * Private (VPC) — customer-managed networking, Redwood control plane optionally deployed in same VPC (private control plane) or we can run an operator in your environment.
  * Air-gapped on-prem — we provide an on-prem bundle + install playbook that does not require outbound model telemetry.
- Data control: model weights and inference data stay in your environment for Private/On-Prem; KMS/HSM integrations for key management.
- Observability + fallbacks: token-level cost/latency breakdowns + rollouts that can fallback to smaller variants if capacity constrained.
- Competitive angle vs hyperscalers: more streamlined inference runtime (lower tail latency), out-of-the-box KV/prefix caching, and an opinionated ops layer for canaries and rollouts.

Proposed next tests for a tight PoC (2-3 weeks)
1) Networking checklist run (we'll verify VPC routing, required ports, TLS and cert exchange) — owners: Tom + Redwood SE
2) Control plane connectivity test (managed vs private control plane options) — confirm whether you allow private peering or prefer operator model
3) Air-gap feasibility runbook review (share our playbook and validate any gaps in your change control)
4) Benchmark: small perf run vs a 8-GPU Dedicated variant and a baseline against AWS Bedrock/Vertex (if you want competitor perf datapoints)

Attachments I shared: redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf, networking-checklist.xlsx (first pass)

Can you confirm: 1) owners for the networking checklist & 2) 1-2 windows next week for the initial connectivity run?

Hi Tom / Priya — quick technical notes to answer the questions and set expectations for the networking checklist: 

1) Control plane connectivity options
- Managed private control plane (preferred for faster onboarding): deployed into your VPC via a private subnet; no internet egress required if you allow private peering and NAT is blocked. In this mode, the control plane components run in your environment and communicate with the runtime over internal network paths.
- Operator model: Redwood provides an operator/container bundle you run in your k8s cluster/on-prem. Operator periodically accepts admin bundles via an offline transfer process for fully air-gapped installs.

2) Air-gapped updates/patches
- We support two flows: 
  a) Scheduled offline bundle exchange (you pull signed update tarballs and apply via our documented playbook).
  b) On-site install support (Redwood can ship encrypted media or run an on-site engagement).
- We provide delta-updates to minimize transfer size and an automated checksum/verification step.

3) Data residency & model weights
- For Private and Air-gapped deployments, model weights are stored on customer-managed storage; no telemetry or model payloads are sent to Redwood's hosted services by default. Any optional telemetry is opt-in and can be toggled off.

4) Networking & ports (high level) — items we'll validate in the checklist:
- Outbound: none required for private control plane if using VPC peering / private subnets.
- Inbound: control plane -> runtime over TLS, default ports 443 + a configurable gRPC port (see attached control-plane-network-ports.txt).
- Time sync / NTP required for cert validation during install.
- Firewall rules and MTU checks for large model transfers if you plan to pull weights from our artifact repo.

Attachments included: airgap-deployment-guide.pdf, control-plane-network-ports.txt, soc2-readiness-stub.pdf

Next tests we recommend for the PoC (technical owner in parentheses)
- Run the networking-checklist.xlsx (Tom) — scheduled test window: 2-3 hours 
- Exchange a signed cert and verify TLS handshake (Rishi/Marissa + Tom)
- Dry run of an offline bundle install in a staging VM (Marissa + Acme infra)
